en: A black-and-white aerial view of a European city center, dominated by a prominent church with a rose window and pointed arches. The square around the church is lined with older buildings and some people walking or cycling. Signs in German are visible on the shopfronts in the foreground, and the distant landscape includes rolling hills and an impressive building complex on the horizon.
